Same building, comparable 1BRs on different floors. These are advertised prices, not completed leases; concessions, services and fees may differ. The $2,000 premium is a planning assumption.

6+

In comparable European furnished-rental settings, core furniture can remain in use for more than six years. We conservatively count only six years here.

European reference: Guestly Homes, Sweden · lifespan varies by item and care ↗See the Edinburgh apartments: Moda, The McEwan · first residents March 2022, now in year five · same original furniture, still in good condition ↗

Assumes continuous rental at the same extra rent for 72 months. Gains deduct the initial furniture + setup cost only; maintenance, replacements, vacancy, taxes and other costs are excluded.

1BR uses an assumed $2,000 monthly premium. Studio, 2BR and 3BR premiums are estimated in proportion to purchase price. Calculations use unrounded amounts; displayed figures are rounded.
